args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's
rounding per FIN-212, but round_money quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP.
Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failing on `tests/test_money.py` was caused by `src/money.py` quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP` while the tests expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switched the quantize rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (matching the docstring, which already claimed this behavior).

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`, confirming `test_half_even` (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`) now succeeds.
